entries.title: A crewmate no longer asks again for a check you already allowed
entries.body: When you have already said yes to what a check uses, such as some of your plan's allowance for a few trial runs, on a card or in words you gave the first mate for the task, the crewmate runs that check without a second card that records the same yes. A yes you give on a check's own card is now kept with your other yeses, so taking it back makes that check ask again, and a check no yes covers still asks you first.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears on screen; the second card that repeated your yes no longer goes up.
